scope: R209: a root-cause hypothesis for issue 15 - HCCL collective reduction order is non-deterministic - with a cheap decisive test
why_this_work: issue 4 (P0, worker-local copy stream and safe prefetch, i.e. candidate 4 weight-stream overlap on the 96.4 percent DiT path) is blocked by issue 15; resolving 15 is the only route that sits on the DiT main path and needs no numeric approval

my_first_hypothesis_refuted.hypothesis: timesteps in denoise_loop.py is a persistent buffer mutated in place and copied asynchronously without synchronisation, so a stale or partial read causes run-to-run variation
my_first_hypothesis_refuted.refutation: line 201 allocates a fresh torch.empty each time and .to(device) also produces new tensors, and the comment states the CPU-then-copy design is deliberate for 910A
my_first_hypothesis_refuted.verdict: not the root cause; recorded so it is not investigated again

encoder_native.extra: deviation already visible at encoder.text.layers.0 post output, event 62

three_independent_pieces_of_evidence.common_factor: three entirely different components are all non-repeatable, so the shared factors are the NPU hardware and libraries, or the collectives

hypothesis.claim: HCCL all-reduce reduction order is non-deterministic
hypothesis.topology_context: encoder runs TP8 with per-layer row-parallel and MLP all-reduce; DiT runs TP2 plus USP4 with several all-reduces per layer; the VAE also gathers tiles
why_it_fits: the deviation accumulates with layer count, matching the encoder 64 layers showing 96 percent differing words
the DiT shows a small but consistently visible relRMS of 0.026 percent
the VAE shows only 1 LSB jitter, consistent with few gathers
one mechanism explains all three with sensible relative magnitudes

decisive_test.method: set HCCL_DETERMINISTIC=1 and repeat the same-input run

outcomes.conclusion: collective reduction order confirmed as root cause
hypothesis refuted, fall back to operator-level non-determinism

decisive_test.cost: only an environment variable on the existing R128/R137 repeat methodology; no code change and no maths change

supporting_separation_tests: single card with no collectives - if that repeats bit-identically, the collectives must be responsible
compare TP2 against TP8 - larger deviation at higher TP would further support the claim
use the no-extra-sync repeat control from the issue 15 checklist so syncs do not mask a race
why_it_matters_for_the_main_goal: issue 4 is P0, on the DiT main path, and is candidate 4 in the objective; determining 15s root cause tells us which synchronisations in the prefetch lifetime are actually required
limits: this round is code audit plus hypothesis only, no test was run, so section five is unverified
I did not check whether HCCL_DETERMINISTIC is supported in this CANN version or whether it covers reduce-scatter and all-gather as well as all-reduce
the R137 note that the encoder deviates at the shallowest layer was not re-checked against possible input-distribution effects
